title: Brazilian Chicken Gratin Casserole
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Brazilian-inspired casserole featuring chicken, cheese, and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
In a greased 9x13-inch casserole dish, arrange half of the chicken breast pieces in a single layer.
Sprinkle with half of the luscious grated cheddar cheese and all of the Brazilian-style grated mozzarella cheese.
Arrange the remaining chicken breast pieces on top.
Sprinkle with the remaining luscious grated cheddar cheese.
In a small bowl, mix the gratin breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the casserole.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the top is golden brown.
Let the casserole rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
